Asset / Process: ATS Web Portal & Candidate PII Database
If an attacker steals staff credentials via phishing alongside shared intern logins and lack of MFA on the ATS portal, then unauthorized users may exfiltrate 45,000+ candidate CVs and NIC records, violating Sri Lanka PDPA and losing enterprise bank clients.
ISO 27001:2022 Control & Mitigation Plan: Annex A.8.5 (Secure Authentication) & A.5.16 (Identity Management): Enforce mandatory Microsoft Entra ID MFA for all staff, prohibit shared intern accounts, and require 12+ character passwords.

If a departing recruiter retains active login credentials alongside a 5-to-7 day delay in HR-to-IT termination notices, then former staff may bulk-download proprietary client job orders and candidate pools for competing agencies.
Existing Controls: Ad-hoc email notification from HR to IT
ISO 27001:2022 Control & Mitigation Plan: Annex A.5.18 (Access Rights) & A.6.5 (Termination Responsibilities): Implement a mandatory HR-IT Offboarding Checklist requiring SSO, M365, and ATS account revocation within 4 hours of employee exit.

If recruiters collect candidate CVs and NIC copies via personal WhatsApp and store them in local laptop Downloads folders alongside unencrypted personal devices, then a lost laptop or malware infection will cause an unreported PII data breach.
ISO 27001:2022 Control & Mitigation Plan: Annex A.5.10 (Acceptable Use) & A.8.12 (Data Leakage Prevention): Prohibit PII sharing over personal WhatsApp; mandate direct candidate uploads via the ATS link and enforce weekly local folder cleanup.

If an AWS IAM access key is leaked or bucket permissions are misconfigured alongside the absence of data retention limits, then historical candidate records going back 5+ years could be publicly exposed.
Existing Controls: Private bucket default setting; no retention rule
ISO 27001:2022 Control & Mitigation Plan: Annex A.8.9 (Configuration Management) & A.8.10 (Information Deletion): Enforce S3 Block Public Access, enable AES-256 encryption at rest, and configure S3 Lifecycle rules to purge inactive CVs after 24 months.

If ransomware or database corruption occurs alongside an untested backup restoration process (untested for 12+ months), then TalentBridge may fail to recover recruitment operations within the 24-hour client SLA.
ISO 27001:2022 Control & Mitigation Plan: Annex A.8.13 (Information Backup): Conduct a quarterly restore test to a staging environment and log recovery time screenshots as audit evidence.

If an after-hours brute-force or anomalous login occurs alongside the lack of a 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC) or commercial SIEM tool, then incident detection may be delayed until the next business morning.
Existing Controls: AWS CloudWatch basic alarms & M365 basic audit logs
ISO 27001:2022 Control & Mitigation Plan: Annex A.8.16 (Monitoring Activities): Risk Accepted by Management due to SME budget constraints (35 staff). Compensating control: Configure free automated AWS CloudWatch email/SMS alerts for root/admin login events.
